policy.title: Allowed and prohibited items
policy.intro: Shawe Mal Marketplace is for relocation-related goods. Listings that break these rules are held for review or removed.

allowed.furniture: Furniture — beds, wardrobes, tables, chairs, sofas
allowed.appliances: Appliances — refrigerators, washing machines, rice cookers

prohibited.wildlife: Wildlife and animal products such as ivory

rules.honest: Describe the item honestly, including defects.
rules.photos: Use real photos of the item you are selling.
rules.contact: Respond to buyers politely through the contact methods you provide.
rules.sold: Mark items as Sold as soon as the sale is complete.
rules.payment: Never ask buyers for deposits or advance payments to unknown accounts.

policy.moderationBody: Listings are checked automatically for prohibited items and reviewed by our team when reported. Repeated violations lead to suspension or a permanent ban.
policy.privacyBody: Your phone number, Telegram, and Viber are only shown to signed-in buyers who tap a contact button on your listing.
